messages:
Frank (CEO): Quick live Q&A from the all-hands: leadership wants a short, evidence-based breakdown of why we win and why we lose + one suggested fix per loss. Keep it punchy for the board packet.

Hannah (PM): From win/loss interviews and renewals: Wins: 1) Dedicated + SLA that matches customer SLIs, 2) transparent committed pricing that maps to token throughput, 3) VPC/KMS + audit trails. Losses: 1) customers can build cheaper at scale (self-host), 2) need for on-prem/air-gapped deployments, 3) lack of a simple rollback/pin UX which hits renewals.

Noah (VP Sales): Sales color: two deals last quarter stalled specifically because the RFP demanded an on-prem appliance. Another recurring pattern: prospects ask for a perf sheet with throughput numbers per SKU. Those close faster.

Jia (Product): Mitigations we can ship quickly: add "pin model" + "revert" in Console (2-week scope), add per-request model-id to logs (1 week), publish perf expectation one-pager (SRE + sales collab). Bigger: on-prem bundle (security review + install/run support) — needs roadmap slot.

Sam (Support): Customer feedback loops: repeated tickets about latency variance during bursts and emergency requests to "roll back" after a model swap. Those correlate strongly with churn risk. Suggest we surface aggregated ticket reasons to Sales weekly.

Ravi (Data): I ran a quick CRM tag rollup (since 2025-09-01): sla_commit=12, need_onprem=7, pin_model=9. I'll attach a CSV mapping lost deals to requested features and conservatively estimate "avoidable churn" by feature.

Frank (CEO): Leadership ask: what single thing would move the needle most in 90 days? My read is: on-prem/offline bundle for regulated/high-ACV prospects. But if pipeline doesn't justify, then pin/rollback + perf sheet to reduce renewals and accelerate closes.

Hannah (PM): Proposed action items: 1) Noah -> list 2 active deals that require on-prem + anonymized RFP text (due Tue). 2) Jia -> RFC for pin/revert + telemetry + acceptance criteria (due Fri). 3) Ben (SRE) -> perf one-pager draft (due Wed). 4) Ravi -> avoidable-churn model + CSV (due Tue). 5) Sam -> upload 3 anonymized ticket snippets showing churn triggers (due Wed). Owners ack?

Noah (VP Sales): Ack. I'll post deal IDs and sanitized RFP lines tomorrow.

Jia (Product): Ack. I'll scope minimal ship and include risk notes.

Sam (Support): Ack. Will paste snippets and recommended runbook for rollback.

Ravi (Data): Ack. I'll include confidence bands.

ops-bot: created doc playbooks/win-loss/q4-2025-board by @Hannah

Frank (CEO): Great. For the board I'd like a one-page that shows: avoidable-churn %, top 3 asks, and our proposed 90-day focus. Hannah, can you own the synthesis?

Hannah (PM): I'll compile everything into the board one-pager and circulation email. ETA Tue EOD.

Frank (CEO): Thanks team. Short and practical is perfect.
